subject: mot-dy
title: MOT.DY.------OBS.
description: Chart on book p. 490 (TRF(II)-26). MOT-DY is the subject; OBS (observation) is the partner. From the subject: PART (participation), INFO-DY and INTR (interpretation). From PART: TR (transformation). From TR: C-HM (composite humanity). From C-HM: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From INFO-DY: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From MT-INTR: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From INTR: INFO-COMP (information compression) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: RE-ST (restructuralism). From RE-ST: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics).
